meta.title: Decrease OpenNext Bundle Size to Below 3MB
meta.body_summary: Reduce OpenNext bundle size below the Cloudflare worker 3MB limit via build config tweaks, dependency removal, and a post-build optimization script; compressed size achieved 2.14MB.

perf_labels.notes: Copilot reduced bundle size with build optimizations and a post-build script; no review or comment, closed without merge.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 468 changed lines, this is a small-to-medium change by absolute volume. As a bundle size optimization PR, it was closed with no review. The lack of engagement suggests process barriers or insufficient evidence for the maintainer.

review_details.concern_detail: No formal review or PR comment text exists. The PR was closed by the maintainer without any explanation.
review_details.performance_claim: Reduce OpenNext bundle compressed size from ~6MB to 2.14MB, raw size from 24MB to 10.11MB.
review_details.rejection_signals: Maintainer closed the PR without review or comment; only Copilot work-started/finished events and a review request with no response.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: No maintainer engagement on a bundle size optimization with explicit metrics. Copilot's PR was closed without review, indicating a process gap where the maintainer did not respond or found the change unsuitable.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: PR body includes a before/after benchmark table but no reproduction steps or profiler data.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: PR closed without merge; no regression cycle occurred.

core_change_summary.description: Configured webpack optimizations, removed @scalar/nextjs-openapi, created a post-build script (optimize-opennext-bundle.js) to strip source maps and minify code, and updated next.config.ts to reduce server-side bundle size.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Lockfile updates reflect dependency changes; sidebar and font changes are incidental modifications.
